newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines chooses Salomon to lead Yankee bond.
newsitem.headline: Philippines chooses Salomon to lead Yankee bond.

text.p: The Philippine Central Bank said on Tuesday it had chosen Salomon Brothers to be the lead underwriter for its Yankee bond issue scheduled to be launched in the second quarter of this year.
The bank said in a statement the issue would be between $750 million to $1.0 billion.
The offering will be the first international issue of the Philippine Central Bank.
Central Bank Governor Gabriel Singson said in a statement the target maturity for the bonds shall be a minimum of 30 years, a portion of which can have a maturity of 100 years.

"The timing for the issue is opportune considering prevailing market conditions and investor interest in Philippine debt papers particularly with the prospect of a credit rating upgrade," Singson said.
Co-lead managers in the offering are JP Morgan, Citicorp, Merrill Lynch, Morgan Stanley and ING Barings, the statement said.

The bonds, which will serve as a benchmark for pricing long-term issues of Philippine borrowers, shall be registered with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission. It shall be used for international reserves management by the Central Bank.
